Skin

Chemical Peel

Experience a skin makeover with our advanced chemical peel treatment. This procedure exfoliates dead skin cells with care. It unveils a fresh, smooth complexion. Our chemical peels refine skin texture and reduce fine lines. They leave your skin looking refreshed, vibrant, and youthful. Transform your skin with a glowing, renewed appearance today. 

Book Now Learn about the treatment

Treatment overview

What is a Chemical Peel?

Chemical peels aim to reduce blemishes, uneven pigmentation, and mild scars. They reveal a smoother, brighter complexion. This treatment enhances skin clarity and radiance, leaving you with a rejuvenated look. Experts recommend many sessions to achieve optimal, long-lasting results.

Chemical peels are better than face cleansers at exfoliating. They use both mechanical and chemical methods to do this. We customise our peels to suit your skin type, ensuring optimal results. Curious about what a chemical peel is? Read our blog for more details!

What to expect

Benefits of a Chemical Peel Treatment

Brighter Skin

Enhancing the colour, clarity, tone, and texture of the skin.

Radiant Complexion

Stimulating the formation of healthy skin cells and new collagen.

Beats Dry Skin

Helps in maintaining your skin hydration and Best version of skin

Pimples, Goodbye!

Helps in reducing acne breakouts.

No More Scars

Treats acne scars and other visible skin imperfections

Younger-looking Skin

Reduces wrinkles, age spots, fine lines, and other signs of aging.

Your appointment

Facelit Chemical Peel Treatment Process

Before

  • Inform your Doctor immediately if you have a glycolic acid allergy.Avoid waxing and bleaching before the procedure.Refrain from using exfoliating scrubs or products with benzoyl peroxide at least 48 hours before treatment.The doctor will assess your skin type, tone, and texture to recommend the best treatment plan.A patch test will be conducted to check your reaction to the chemical agent.

During

  • The doctor will cleanse the treatment area before your chemical peel session.A brush is used to apply the chemical solution.The peel remains on your skin for 3 to 5 minutes, depending on the solution used.You may experience mild discomfort during the application.A neutralizing solution is then used to remove the peel.Cool compresses are applied to soothe your skin, followed by hydrating cream and sunscreen.

After

  • Avoid sun exposure and heat during the healing process.Apply broad-spectrum sunscreen throughout the day.Refrain from waxing, threading, or bleaching the treated area for a week.Avoid using Retin-A or other sensitive products on the treated area for 72 hours post-treatment.Do not pick, peel, or scratch the treated skin.Keep your skin hydrated with a moisturizer.

Why Facelit

Why Choose Facelit for the Chemical Peel Treatment?

    Choosing Facelit for your chemical peel guarantees top care and results. We commit to personalised treatment and advanced techniques. Our expert team uses the latest, tailored chemical peel formulations. They address your specific skin concerns: acne, hyperpigmentation, and fine lines. We start with a thorough consultation. It will assess your skin's needs. Then, we will create a customised treatment plan. It will maximise effectiveness while minimising risks.At Facelit, we prioritise your comfort and safety. We maintain the highest hygiene standards in a relaxing environment. Our professionals aim to provide a seamless experience. We want each chemical peel to improve skin texture, tone, and radiance. With our expertise and advanced treatments, trust Facelit. We will help you achieve a healthier, more youthful complexion.For more detailed insights into chemical peel treatments, including safety and techniques, you can explore resources: Best Chemical Peel in Trivandrum: Revitalize Your Skin Naturally with Facelit
